questions: O28's rule in whitepaper §11.3 is SORT-width; I90 states it as a PAR law (P3 over two channels of one function) so the catalog does not move. Should a later key add a Go store channel to SORT-width (a catalog bump) and map O28 to a SORT law, or is the PAR law over the two channels the obligation?
Is P3 (branch: two paths of one function) the right sub-form for two stores of one call that each record one count, or should it be P9 (recompute: a value one path stores and another recomputes)?

The law is over one Append from the receiver's zero value with 65,536 hashes (one block); a real batch reaches 65,536 across blocks (the instrument shows 64 calls of 1,024 wrap the same way). Is the one-call law, with its witness, O28 as you mean it?
